_meta.name: correlation_matrix
_meta.description: Pearson correlation matrix of price, income and label in upper-triangle encoding: a virtual vector names the three fields once and MAT_CORRELATION returns every pairwise r (the arithmetic of TEST_PEARSON_R) plus the matrix determinant; params.summary.top_pairs lists the two strongest pairs by |r| under vectors.top_pairs. Per-pair p-values and intervals come with params.inference (13_correlation_inference.json).
